approved_classes.ex:AminoAcid: Amino acid, any of a group of organic molecules that contain a basic amino group (NH2) and an acidic carboxyl group (COOH).
approved_classes.ex:Protein: Protein is made up of amino acids, which are the building blocks of the molecule.
approved_classes.ex:ChemicalSubstance: A general class for chemical substances.
approved_classes.ex:Element: Element, a fundamental substance in chemistry.
approved_classes.ex:BiologicalProcess: A process related to biological functions.
approved_classes.ex:Disease: A medical condition affecting the body.
approved_classes.ex:ChemicalReaction: A process where one or more substances are transformed into one or more new substances.
approved_classes.ex:PhysicalProperty: A property that can be observed without changing the chemical identity of a substance.
approved_classes.ex:OpticalProperty: A property related to the interaction of light with a substance.
approved_classes.ex:Classification: A categorization of amino acids based on their properties and functions.
approved_classes.ex:EssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are not synthesized by the human body and must be obtained from food.
approved_classes.ex:NonEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be synthesized by the human body and do not need to be obtained from food.
approved_classes.ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are required in the diet of growing children but not for mature individuals.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be used to make fat and are transformed into ketone bodies.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that have part of their carbon skeleton entering the ketogenic pathway and the other part entering the glucogenic pathway.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be used as a starting point for the production of glucose or glycogen.
approved_classes.ex:NonPolarAminoAcid: Amino acids that are hydrophobic and have no charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNoCharge: Amino acids that have an uncharged 'R' group but contribute to protein structure hydrogen bonding.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveCharge: Amino acids that have a positive charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeCharge: Amino acids that have a negative charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:AlphaAminoAcid: Amino acids where the amino group is attached to the next carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:BetaAminoAcid: Amino acids where the amino group is attached to the third carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:GammaAminoAcid: Amino acids where the amino group is attached to the fourth carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:HeterocyclicAminoAcid: Amino acids that have a heterocyclic ring in their structure.
